pinExplorer: Keep File Explorer in the Dock
pinExplorerHint: When off, it appears only while its windows are open.
themeHint: For the dock, the menu bar and their menus. Glass themes look solid when Windows transparency effects are off or energy saver is on.
themeDockHint: For the dock and its menus. Glass themes look solid when Windows transparency effects are off or energy saver is on.
menuBarThemeSame: Same theme for the menu bar
menuBarThemeSameHint: Turn off to give the menu bar and its panels a theme of their own.
magnificationHint: Icons grow as the pointer passes over them.
genieHint: While it is on, windows do not use the Windows animations for maximizing or closing.
genieSpeedHint: How long windows take to fly into the dock and back.
genieOffHint: Turn on Animation effects in Windows to play this effect.
showOtherWorkspacesHint: Reuse open windows across Windows virtual desktops and compatible tiling workspaces, such as komorebi's Cloak mode.
menuBarHint: Time, battery, and access to the Windows quick settings and notifications.
menuBarAutoHideHint: Rest the pointer at the top edge to reveal it.
menuBarHidingVisibleHint: Always shown. Maximized windows open below it.
menuBarHidingIntelligentHint: Shows only when nothing covers it: it hides while the active window reaches under it. Rest the pointer at the top edge to reveal it.
menuBarMusicHint: Music and video, with controls. With music and AI off, the island disappears.
islandStyleHint: Choose between the centered notch or a compact bubble next to the status indicators.
accessoryBatteryHint: Supported mice and headsets. No device queries while off.
menuBarSystemMonitorHint: CPU, memory and network speed next to the status icons. Clicking it opens Task Manager. Nothing is measured while off.
menuBarNotificationsHint: A bell at the right end that opens the Windows notification center.
clockTargetDefault: Notifications and calendar, as on the taskbar.
aiUsageHint: Uses your existing sessions; checks every 5 min. Never saves credentials.
saveError: The settings could not be saved.
checkUpdatesHint: Settings asks GitHub whether there is a newer version when it opens.
autoUpdateHint: Installs new versions once a day.
updatesError: Could not check. Check your connection.
showRecentsHint: The last three you opened that are not pinned.
jumpListsHint: Right-clicking an app lists its recent files, pinned items and tasks, as on the Windows taskbar.
mascotHint: It comes out for AI plans, the battery, the network, the recycle bin, a new version and to say hello each day. Hover over it.
mascotBreakHint: After 90 minutes of work without a pause, it yawns along the Dock.
resetHint: Back to the out-of-the-box look and behavior. Your pinned apps stay.
updateBannerBody: It brings improvements and fixes. It installs in seconds and the dock comes back on its own.
updateInstallError: The update could not be installed. Check your connection and try again.
shortcutsFolderHint: Open a folder's contents from the Dock.
githubError: Could not open GitHub. Try again.
dockHidingVisibleHint: Keep the Dock visible while you work.
dockHidingAutomaticHint: Hidden until you rest the pointer at its edge, even on the desktop.
dockHidingIntelligentHint: Visible on the desktop. Hides when the active window overlaps it.
wallpaperGalleryHint: Downloads once when selected; saved wallpapers work offline.
wallpaperApplyError: Could not download or apply the wallpaper. Try again.
menuBarCircleMenuHint: Settings, Force Quit, sleep, restart, shut down, lock and sign out.
menuBarIconRules: PNG (best, with a transparent background), ICO, JPG or BMP. Square, from 32 × 32 to 1024 × 1024 pixels (128 × 128 recommended), up to 1 MB. Colors show as they are: use white on a dark bar, black on a light one.
menuBarIconBadFormat: That file is not a PNG, ICO, JPG or BMP image.
menuBarIconTooBig: That file is larger than 1 MB.
menuBarIconBadSize: That image is smaller than 32 or larger than 1024 pixels.
menuBarIconSaveFailed: The image could not be saved.
menuBarIconAnimation: Animate the icon and its menu
menuBarIconAnimationHint: Off, or with Windows animation effects off, they change at once.
menuBarDynamicArrowHint: Points down while the menu is closed and up while it is open.
trayMenuHint: Off, the arrow opens Windows' own tray menu.
networkMenuHint: Off, the network icon opens Windows' list of networks.
menuBarCalendarHint: The clock opens a calendar. Off, it opens the notification center. An app chosen for the clock below takes its place.
controlCenterHint: Off, its button opens Windows quick settings.
searchEnabledHint: Find apps, files, settings and definitions, and do calculations. Off, the menu bar's search button opens Windows Search.
searchShortcutHint: Click, then press the new shortcut.
searchShortcutRecording: Press a shortcut, or Esc to cancel.
searchShortcutInvalid: Use Ctrl, Alt or Win with a letter, a number, an F key or Space.
searchShortcutTaken: Another app is using this shortcut. {shortcut} works instead.
searchShortcutNone: No shortcut is available. Use the menu bar's search button.
searchNotRunning: Search is not running. It starts with the dock.
searchWindowHint: Its theme and language follow Muelle.
searchShowContentsHint: Uses the Windows Search index. Start with in: to see only these.
searchDictionaryMissing: English only. To add them, copy the WordNet 3.1 files to %LOCALAPPDATA%\Muelle\dictionary.
searchLearn: Rank what you open often higher
searchCustomAddressHint: An http or https address with {query} where the words go.
searchKeywordsHint: Type a keyword and then your words to search one site.
searchActionError: Search did not respond. Check that the dock is running.
